evidence_retrieval.metadata: Save original API response body plus observation time and parsed projection; exact repository/head/run/attempt/job/artifact identities.
evidence_retrieval.logs: Fetch complete terminal job log, preserve original decoded UTF8 bytes and length/SHA256/Git hash; do not treat console tail as complete test evidence.
evidence_retrieval.artifacts: Use only returned artifact URL in an isolated evidence directory; verify advertised compressed size/digest, ZIP CRC and every member length/hash; never print signed URL. Prefer already recovered originals.
evidence_retrieval.large_artifacts: Read needed small result archives first. Do not download large V8 archives/video bundles solely for a summary. Metadata-only status remains metadata-only.
evidence_retrieval.case_projection: Exact (classname/binary,name,target,platform,run,attempt,shard,test-attempt). Preserve failure/error XML type/message, ignored/skipped/rerun nodes and complete stdout/stderr. Wrapper XML does not establish individual child cases.
evidence_retrieval.libtest_names: Normalize only exact known optional ` - should panic` display suffix before the ellipsis; preserve original line and use full exact-name match, not substring.
evidence_retrieval.duplicates: Identical collector copies or duplicated console/artifact output are one physical observation; retain all provenance. Distinct original test attempts stay distinct.
evidence_retrieval.successful_targets: Read selected-target-retention manifest first. PASS-with-cache, executed PASS, NOT_REPORTED, missing local log and failed copy remain separate. Do not read unreported old directories or equate mtime with invocation identity.
evidence_retrieval.early_returns: Compare raw bodies to historical25 named watchlist and inspect new explicit early-return messages; PASS with omitted behavior is not behavioral qualification.
evidence_retrieval.immutable_publication: Freeze bounded completed batches with raw manifests; compress transport if needed, each Git blob<=512KiB, create+GET byte equality and original-file reconstruction hash. Never rewrite prior snapshots.
